passages.text: Our class makes a small garden guide for next year's pupils. Before the maps and pictures, the introduction explains why we made it and how to use it. At first, the opening is so long that two readers stop before the first map. We shorten it to four clear sentences and add a question for the readers. Then we send a copy by email to a younger class and ask for comments. Their teacher replies that the shorter opening helps the children start exploring. We keep both versions to see how our writing improves.

parallelText.zh: 地图和图片前面的引言解释了编写原因和使用方法。

parallelText.en: At first, the opening is so long that two readers stop before the first map.
parallelText.zh: 起初，开头太长，两名读者还没看到第一张地图就停下了。

parallelText.en: We shorten it to four clear sentences and add a question for the readers.
parallelText.zh: 我们把它缩成四句清楚的话，再给读者加一个问题。

parallelText.en: Then we send a copy by email to a younger class and ask for comments.
parallelText.zh: 随后，我们通过邮件把副本发给低年级班，征求意见。

parallelText.en: Their teacher replies that the shorter opening helps the children start exploring.
parallelText.zh: 他们的老师回复说，较短的开头帮助孩子开始探索。

parallelText.en: We keep both versions to see how our writing improves.
parallelText.zh: 我们保留两个版本，查看文字怎样改进。

passages.text: Mia's dream is to design machines that can explore places people cannot easily reach. The science club offers a chance to speak with an engineer, so she writes her name down. She first plans ten questions, but the group has only fifteen minutes. Mia chooses one question about testing a small model before building a larger machine. The engineer asks about her idea and listens as she explains her drawing. Afterwards, Mia adds two notes to her design instead of throwing the first plan away. The meeting gives her a clearer next step, although more work remains.

parallelText.en: Mia's dream is to design machines that can explore places people cannot easily reach.
parallelText.zh: 米娅的梦想是设计能探索人类不易到达之地的机器。

parallelText.en: The science club offers a chance to speak with an engineer, so she writes her name down.
parallelText.zh: 科学社团提供和工程师交谈的机会，她报名参加。

parallelText.en: She first plans ten questions, but the group has only fifteen minutes.
parallelText.zh: 她起初准备十个问题，但小组只有十五分钟。

parallelText.en: Mia chooses one question about testing a small model before building a larger machine.
parallelText.zh: 米娅选出一个问题，询问制造大机器前怎样测试小模型。

parallelText.en: The engineer asks about her idea and listens as she explains her drawing.
parallelText.zh: 工程师询问她的想法，听她解释图纸。

parallelText.en: Afterwards, Mia adds two notes to her design instead of throwing the first plan away.
parallelText.zh: 之后，米娅在设计上增加两条笔记，而不是丢掉最初方案。

parallelText.en: The meeting gives her a clearer next step, although more work remains.
parallelText.zh: 会面让她更清楚下一步，但仍有更多工作要做。
